summary: Delete test-only full-read ReadPoint, the unbound restore-allocation shim and pin reindexing; detach and forget a former pool's backup repositories on join rehome and eject; sweep SMB3 credential temp files at Run start; keep ordinary receipt retirement off the backup lock; bound retired tombstones in credential projections; start the backup health probe from the Run loop on a state copy. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Join/eject now also unmounts and forgets the former pool's backup repositories; the older unbound restore allocation note no longer applies.

api.reason: No route, field or status changes. The peer credential projection keeps its shape and lists at most 64 retired references.

roadmap.reason: Legacy removal and defect fixes in the existing backup destination slice.

state.record: Core's pool-backup-repositories.json and backup mount units; a pool change now removes the former pool's records and mounts. A fresh Controller reads repositories from the pool master's inventory.
state.reason: No Controller state is added; cleanup runs in Core's own join rehome and eject re-initialization.

verification.method: Four focused Go regressions (also with -race), each red against a single-fix mutant via go test -overlay; focused agent backup/credential/eject/join/run suites, vmhost backup/managed suites and the protocol package passed.
verification.limits: Simulated stores and a stubbed detach; no lab join/eject with a real NFS/SMB3 mount. The probe snapshot has no dedicated race test.
